$comment: Per-repo settings read by the sydevs `workflow` plugin. Replaces the 'Intentional per-repo deltas' table that used to live in three hand-synced copies of .claude/docs/workflow-parity.md.

contractStep.description: Refresh the generated CMS + OpenAPI contracts from SahajCloud main.

worktreeNotes: Copy .env.local from the main checkout if the branch needs it.

generatedFiles.reason: `dist/` is build output from `pnpm build`. Never edit it by hand — change the source under `src/` and rebuild.

`src/types/payload/` is generated by `pnpm types:cms`, which curls the schema from SahajCloud's main branch. To change these types the upstream SahajCloud schema must change and be merged first — see /cross-repo-issue.
`pnpm-lock.yaml` is generated by pnpm. Change dependencies with `pnpm add` / `pnpm remove` / `pnpm update` and let pnpm rewrite the lockfile.

prAllowlistNote: Where a TICKETLESS PR may be opened without a `ready-to-implement` issue: dependency bumps, lint/format sweeps, generated-type re-syncs, doc corrections. Ticket work is gated on the `ready-to-implement` label instead, never on these globs.
